invariant: A live unique label with zero incoming BR/BRZ/BRNZ targets in the entire SIR has only its fallthrough predecessor. It preserves key0-or-unchanged-entry-root or positive completed-access witness. Any incoming branch, duplicate label or dead predecessor kills the witness. Closed-mode admission excludes indirect/unknown transfer; every explicit or coalesced root assignment invalidates the witness. Descriptor registers are unchanged by admitted label flush under the three-local/three-temp contract. Original access/trap position, index bounds and fuel remain.
scope: Valid typed SIR and supervisor metadata; no arbitrary corrupt memory or arbitrary private callers.
